name: shapelessai
title: ShapelessAI
description: Schedule and publish social media posts from Raycast, or ask Raycast AI to do it, on every account you connected to ShapelessAI
author: shapelessai

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Your ShapelessAI API key (starts with slk_). Create one at shapelessai.com/docs/api

commands.name: create-post
commands.title: Create Post
commands.subtitle: ShapelessAI
commands.description: Queue, schedule or publish a post on one of your connected social accounts

commands.name: recent-posts
commands.title: Recent Posts
commands.subtitle: ShapelessAI
commands.description: Browse your scheduled, published and failed posts

tools.name: list-accounts
tools.title: List Accounts
tools.description: Lists the social accounts the user connected to ShapelessAI, with the id to pass as connectionId when creating a post.

tools.name: create-post
tools.title: Create Post
tools.description: Creates a post on one connected social account. By default it goes into the account's next free queue slot; pass scheduledAt (ISO 8601) for a set time, or publishNow to post at once.

tools.name: list-posts
tools.title: List Posts
tools.description: Lists the user's recent posts, newest first, optionally filtered by status (proposed, scheduled, published, failed, canceled).

ai.instructions: ShapelessAI posts to the user's own social accounts. Call list-accounts first to get a connectionId. Keep the user's text as written unless they ask for edits. Prefer the queue unless the user names a time or says now.
